2608.16645.title: Reconstruction: A Blind Benchmark for Recovering Research Ideas from Pre-Publication Bibliographies
2608.16645.paper_summary: Can a language model recover the true research idea of a published paper when given only that paper's pre-publication bibliography? We introduce Reconstruction, a blind idea-recovery benchmark that withholds the seed paper and all contemporaneous or future literature, and asks models to propose hypotheses that an independent large language model judge matches against the held-out ground-truth idea. A strict anti-leakage protocol-temporal citation cutoff, anonymous reference IDs, and frozen per-paper bibliographies, which prevents prompt-time leakage of the seed idea. Across six scientific domains and 643 evaluated papers, seven frontier models achieve only modest Match rates (approx. 3-15%). We then evaluate a reference-only multi-agent (top 4) pipeline that combines cross-model review with a Swiss tournament over aligned hypothesis slots, without external web search. Cross-model review plus tournament selection raises Match rates to approx. 23-42% across all six domains, which is an observed approx. 2.4x lift over the best single-model baseline. This draft reports the protocol, anti-leakage design, and current results as an arXiv timestamp.
2608.16645.paper_summary_zh: 一個語言模型能否在僅提供該論文的發表前文獻的情況下，恢復出已發表論文的真實研究思想？我們介紹了重建（Reconstruction），這是一個盲目的思想恢復基準，隱藏了種子論文及所有同時期或未來的文獻，並要求模型提出假設，讓一個獨立的大型語言模型評估這些假設是否與保留的真實思想相符。嚴格的反洩漏協議——時間引用截止、匿名參考ID，以及凍結的每篇論文的參考文獻，這些措施防止了在提示時洩漏種子思想。在六個科學領域和643篇評估論文中，七個前沿模型僅達到適度的匹配率（約3-15%）。然後，我們評估了一個僅參考的多代理（前四名）管道，該管道結合了跨模型評審和對齊假設槽的瑞士錦標賽，無需外部網絡搜索。跨模型評審加上錦標賽選擇將所有六個領域的匹配率提高到約23-42%，這比最佳單模型基準觀察到的約2.4倍提升。本草稿報告了協議、反洩漏設計和當前結果，作為arXiv時間戳。
